name: aiterm-mcp
description: Launch Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok CLI, or Cursor Agent CLI through one harness API, plus durable terminals.
long_description: Give any MCP client one persistent terminal for SSH, containers, REPLs, and interactive coding-agent TUIs. The canonical agent_launch tool selects the execution harness separately from its model, so Cursor may run GPT, Claude, or Grok while Cursor still owns the session, hooks, and transcript. Reads are token-reduced, sessions survive client restarts, and humans can attach to the shared tmux session or native Windows psmux 3.3.8+ session.

tools.name: pty_open
tools.description: Open one persistent tmux-backed POSIX or psmux 3.3.8+-backed native Windows terminal session.

tools.name: pty_send
tools.description: Send text to a persistent terminal or dispatch a turn to a managed agent.

tools.name: pty_read
tools.description: Read token-reduced terminal output or a managed agent transcript.

tools.name: pty_key
tools.description: Send a control or navigation key to a terminal session.

tools.name: pty_close
tools.description: Close one persistent terminal session idempotently.

tools.name: pty_list
tools.description: List the persistent terminal sessions owned by aiterm.

tools.name: pty_observe
tools.description: Observe session and harness liveness, native process identity, and terminal activity.

tools.name: agent_launch
tools.description: Launch an agent through a canonical harness-based interface.

tools.name: claude_agent
tools.description: Deprecated alias for agent_launch with the Claude Code harness.

tools.name: codex_agent
tools.description: Deprecated alias for agent_launch with the Codex CLI harness.

tools.name: grok_agent
tools.description: Deprecated alias for agent_launch with the Grok CLI harness.

tools.name: agent_configure
tools.description: Change the model or reasoning effort of a running Claude, Codex, Grok, Composer, or Cursor session.

tools.name: agent_steer
tools.description: Steer an active Codex or Grok turn without starting a new turn.

tools.name: agent_approval
tools.description: Inspect a Codex approval and submit a digest-bound one-time approval or denial.

tools.name: claude_turn
tools.description: Issue or recover a correlated managed Claude operation.

tools.name: claude_approval
tools.description: Inspect and answer a correlated managed Claude approval prompt.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Return a read-only, privacy-bounded factory readiness snapshot.
